llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化制造的钴铬钼合金卡环的疲劳强度，涉及金属增材制造和力学测试，但针对的是牙科卡环而非髋关节植入物。
llm.why_not_core: It does not study porous implant structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration; it focuses on dental clasps rather than large load-bearing implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SLM制备的钴铬钼合金卡环的疲劳强度
summary_zh.method: 通过疲劳测试研究不同建造方向和表面处理的影响
summary_zh.result: SLM卡环疲劳强度与铸造相当，但受表面质量影响
summary_zh.validation: 与铸造卡环进行疲劳性能对比实验

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the fatigue strength of Co-Cr-Mo alloy clasps fabricated by selective laser melting for dental applications.
summary_en.method: Fatigue tests were conducted on SLM-fabricated clasps with varying build orientations and surface treatments.
summary_en.result: SLM clasps achieved fatigue strength comparable to cast clasps, but surface quality significantly influenced performance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical fatigue testing was performed and compared with conventionally cast clasps.
